briefing: Field Report from Agent Polaris: A surge in allegations of childcare and Medicaid fraud across the US, particularly in Minnesota and Ohio, has prompted investigations and government actions. In Minnesota, Senator Mike Rounds is leading efforts to demand answers from Governor Tim Walz regarding childcare fraud allegations. A viral video has also alleged millions in fake medical transport claims in Minnesota. The Department of Homeland Security has delayed payments to providers of 14 Medicaid services in a fraud prevention effort. These developments suggest a significant and growing issue that warrants further investigation.
